sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 price adjustment: counterproposal and request for cost breakdown
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for twelve years of reliable supply. We want to keep the foundry strong. However, +8.8 % on our current EUR 48.60 is more than the drivers you cite.

By your own figures, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % and makes up 28 % of your cost, which adds about 0.9 % to cost.

Could you share a cost breakdown for PH-100, including your energy share?

In return for a lower price, we can offer planning security through a 24-month contract at the full 4,000 pcs per year. Please see the three alternative packages attached.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We highly value our twelve-year partnership and welcome your proposal for a 24-month agreement to ensure mutual planning security. Building on your third package, we can reduce our price to €51.60, provided we maintain the 30-day payment terms and the December 1st effective date. 

Our current offer is a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

My colleagues will address your questions regarding our cost structure and energy share separately. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: revised packages for a 24-month agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for moving to EUR 51.60 and for welcoming the 24-month agreement.

Our figure came from your own e-mail: you stated that WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % and is 28 % of your cost. That gives about 0.9 % on cost.

We would value a short view of how SCRAP-E3 and GAS-TTF have moved for PH-100, so that we can understand the remaining gap to +6.2 %.

We want a healthy partner. To help you, we can be flexible on payment terms and on the start date. Please see the three revised packages attached.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.subject: PH-100: closing the gap on the 24-month agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the move to EUR 51.40. We appreciate that we are close.

At EUR 51.40, the increase on our current EUR 48.60 is still 5.8 %. Without figures for SCRAP-E3 and GAS-TTF, we cannot yet explain that level internally.

We accept your 30-day payment terms and the 1 December start. In return we would ask for a further step on price. We have also included options with a later start date or longer payment terms, in case those suit you better.

Please see the three packages attached. If none of them works, which part of your cost makes EUR 51.40 the floor?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to build on the long relationship between our companies. We appreciate your acceptance of the 30-day payment terms and the December 1st start date for a 24-month agreement. 

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. For this reason, we must maintain our offer of €51.40 for this package. Our offer consists of a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Please understand that our margin and our limits stay internal. While our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF, the figures stay with us. My colleagues will address your questions regarding our cost structure separately.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: final step towards agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your clear position and for the commitment to a 24-month agreement. We understand that your margin and cost figures stay internal, and we respect that.

We are very close. To close this week, we suggest one small final step.

The first option keeps your price of EUR 51.40, with the new price applying from 1 January 2027.

The second option keeps 1 December and sets the price at EUR 51.30.

Both options keep 30-day payment terms and the full 4,000 pcs per year over 24 months.

If either works for you, we are ready to sign promptly.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing
